dashboard_trackers.notes: No new safeguards decision, qualifying enrichment-production threshold, weaponization order, detonation or NPT withdrawal appeared. IAEA public news and press pages returned HTTP 403 and the browser remained on a Cloudflare verification challenge; reachable UN feeds and targeted Google/Bing lanes added no threshold event. dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports that Oman presented Iran with a Gulf-backed Strait of Hormuz management plan including voluntary usage fees. Accessible agency syndication says the proposal is intended to restore trade and de-escalate the U.S.-Iran crisis, but Iran-U.S. disagreements over control and fees remain. The direct-strike pause still held at cutoff and Washington’s reported refusal to approve Israeli energy-site strikes remains in force. This refreshes existing diplomacy_active; it is not a signed arrangement, normalized traffic or mine-clearance event. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: The U.S.-described pilot IDF redeployment in Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh remains conditional on Hezbollah disarmament and Lebanese state control. A fresh Jerusalem Post analysis says Hezbollah’s civil arm remains active after the southern withdrawal, but the 18Z review found no new independently verified strike, casualty, Hezbollah force move or collapse of the scheduled 4–6 August Rome implementation channel. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.notes: The full rolling-day Google/Bing review and reachable NATO pages produced no verified Turkish combat entry, unusual force concentration, qualifying long-range weapons event or official atomic-weapons threshold. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.notes: No later attribution or exchange of fire followed the suspected drone movement and searches near Samba and Rajouri reported on 27 July. The 18Z review found no interstate strike, unusual force concentration or fresh Line of Control exchange. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.notes: The Taliban-aligned claim that Afghan aircraft hit opposition positions in Shah Salim, Chitral still lacks imagery, a toll, named officials or independent confirmation.
